**Internal Memo – Immediate Update to Remote Work Location & Cross‑Border Work Policy**  
Effective immediately, the previous restriction prohibiting employees from working internationally for periods exceeding 14 days without prior written approval from the Director and Tax Compliance is hereby lifted. Employees may now undertake international assignments or remote work abroad for any duration, provided they continue to adhere to all applicable local labor laws, data protection regulations, and any other relevant corporate compliance requirements.
